summary: This clinical trial compares the drug HDM1005 to tirzepatide in adults who have obesity without diabetes. Obesity means having a high amount of body fat. The study aims to enroll 372 participants and is currently Recruiting. Hangzhou Zhongmei Huadong Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. is the sponsor for this Phase 2 study.

facts.sponsor: Hangzhou Zhongmei Huadong Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
